text:
carmen: confession: i named my local finetune 'bean-counter' and now it sends me motivational quotes every morning. :bean:
leo: do you have a screenshot? this is peak culture content.
carmen: pasted (safe demo):
```
bean-counter v0.1: "You are capable of batching beautifully. Remember to hydrate."
```
anya: i made 'sir-snips-a-lot' who trims prompts and leaves passive-aggressive comments. he once removed my entire preface and wrote 'you're welcome'. :scissors:
leo: sir-snips-a-lot is my vibe. can we get t-shirts that say "I prune prompts, not feelings"?
dev-bot: poll created: "Merch idea" Options: T-shirt, Mug, Sticker sheet
carmen: voted Sticker sheet (tiny beans for everyone)
anya: also made a LinkedIn headline for bean-counter: "Optimizes token economy • Team player • Snacks occasionally"
leo: the snacks line is crucial. also who else anthropomorphizes metrics? my graphs now have names. latency is "Larry".
carmen: Larry sends passive-aggressive spikes on Mondays. we play calming playlists to soothe him.
ops-bot: reminder: keep memes SFW and do not include customer data.
anya: tiny tradition idea: 'Model Mutuals' 1 cards where each card has a persona, quirks, and a one-liner like "Will ask 3 clarifying q's before bed." could be good onboarding fluff.
leo: challenge accepted. i'll design 'Larry' the latency plush. no snacks near hardware though.
carmen: if we actually produce merch i'll buy 5 stickers. tagging @design in spirit. :sparkles:
